name: Library Employee
query:
SELECT
    `tabEmployee`.`employee_name` as `Employee Name:Link/Employee:160`,
    `tabEmployee`.`gender` as `Gender:Data:100`,
    `tabEmployee`.`date_of_birth` as `DOB:Date:100`,
    `tabEmployee`.`custom_employment_type` as `Employment Type:Data:100`,
    `tabEmployee`.`date_of_joining` as `Date Of Joining:Data:140`,
    `tabEmployee`.`status` as `Status:Data:100`,
    `tabEmployee`.`department` as `Department:Data:130`,
    `tabEmployee`.`cell_number` as `Mobile No:Int:140`,
    `tabEmployee`.`personal_email` as `Personal Email:Data:202`
FROM    
    `tabEmployee`
